// Lint fixture: every flagged line ends with a marker `expect: <rule>[,<rule>]`; unmarked lines must stay clean.
import { defineFilm, scene } from '../lib/timeline.js';
import { mulberry32, rngFor } from '../lib/rng.js';

const shared = mulberry32(7);
const jitter = Math.random() * 4; // expect: no-math-random
const started = Date.now(); // expect: no-date
const stamp = new Date(); // expect: no-date
const tick = performance.now(); // expect: no-date
setTimeout(() => {}, 100); // expect: no-timers
setInterval(() => {}, 100); // expect: no-timers
requestAnimationFrame(() => {}); // expect: no-raf
fetch('https://example.com/data.json'); // expect: no-remote-fetch
const face = new FontFace('Inter', 'url(https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter.woff2)'); // expect: no-remote-fetch
const gsapLike = { repeat: -1, yoyo: true }; // expect: no-infinite-repeat
const waapi = { iterations: Infinity }; // expect: no-infinite-repeat
const id = crypto.randomUUID(); // expect: no-random-uuid

export default defineFilm((ctx) => {
  const perFilm = rngFor('film');
  return {
    scenes: [
      scene(0, 2, 'hook', (g, lt, c) => {
        const x = shared() * c.W; // expect: shared-rng
        const y = perFilm() * c.H; // expect: shared-rng
        const own = rngFor('hook', 1);
        g.fillRect(x, y, own() * 10, 10);
        el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s'; // expect: no-css-transition
        el.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], 300); // expect: no-css-transition
        el.style.willChange = 'transform'; // expect: no-will-change
      }),
    ],
  };
});
